title: "Graduated Very Young From Columbia." The Record Says No

lines.say: Graduated very young from Columbia. That's what Martin Shkreli claimed, an investor testified. Columbia's registrar testified he never enrolled.
lines.show: "Graduated very young from Columbia." That's what Martin Shkreli claimed, an investor testified. Columbia's registrar testified he never enrolled.

lines.say: The auditor he named for his fund? He stipulated the firm never provided it any services.
His report after a trade wiped out almost all the fund's capital? It said up six point seven percent in March.
lines.show: His report after a trade wiped out almost all the fund's capital? It said up 6.7% in March.

lines.say: The jury convicted him of securities fraud. Seven years in federal prison.
Real trials. Real evidence. The verdict.
